summary: A small colored label used to flag status or a count, like a notification dot or a count bubble.
description: A simple badge element that can be used to indicate status or convey simple messages.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Text to display on the badge, by default inferred from type (falls back to a fluent id per type when unset).

attributes.name: iconSrc
attributes.description: The src for an optional icon shown next to the label.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The title of the badge, appears as a tooltip on hover.
